**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md) · **Design spec:** [`docs/design/khala-chat/RECREATION-SPEC.md`](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/design/khala-chat/RECREATION-SPEC.md) §1, §2, §3, §12, §14–§18, §21
**Exclusive write surfaces:**
- **Existing files:** `apps/web/index.html`, `apps/web/src/brand/tokens.css`, `apps/web/src/brand/fonts.css`, `apps/web/src/main.css` (body rules), `apps/web/src/shell/{shell.css,AiurShell.tsx,AiurShell.test.tsx,shell.browser.spec.ts,shell.visual.spec.ts,shell.visual.spec.ts-snapshots/**,browser-harness/**}`, `apps/web/src/composition/human/hosted-config.ts` + `hosted-config.test.ts` (CSP only), `apps/web/src/composition/human/screen.tsx` (shell chrome).

## Outcome

- The signed-in app is one full-viewport `.kh-card`. It has no topbar, no 260px nav and no drawer.
- The design tokens (both themes) and the design's fonts are active. The **logo font (Bungee) appears only on the `.kh-brand .wm` wordmark.**
- Every later design ticket imports the shared primitives instead of re-creating them: avatar, identity and hue, time formatting, icons, popover, segment, switch, buttons, toast, tooltip, and the per-area CSS files (empty stubs).
- Behaviour is unchanged: the list, thread, composer and detail still work, rendered by the existing components in their new files.

## Context and evidence

- The roster's design lane is gated by G-DESIGN, which is satisfied: `docs/design/khala-chat/` holds the full import and the spec.
- KM-120 rewrites `mount.tsx`, `room.tsx` and `main.tsx`, so this ticket starts after KM-120 (roster change: was "— (gate G-DESIGN)").
- **Operator directive:** use the Claude Design UI font stacks verbatim, and use the logo font only on the logo (spec §2.1).
- The design: `docs/design/khala-chat/source/Aiur Dashboard.html`. Tokens at `:25-127`, base at `:129-153`, Khala CSS at `:413-771`, shell markup at `:2071-2102`. The reference captures are `docs/design/khala-chat/reference/screens/fullbleed-*.png` and the computed values are in `reference/computed-styles.json`.

## Scope

1. **Tokens and fonts** (§2.1, §2.2):
   - Add the Google Fonts preconnects and link verbatim to `apps/web/index.html`.
   - Define the design tokens and base rules on `.khala-app` and `.khala-app[data-theme="light"]`.
   - Keep the `--khala-*` names as aliases (§2.2 list).
   - Delete `--khala-font-heading`.
   - Fix the two logo-font misuses: `shell/shell.css:27` and `:270-274`.
2. **CSP** (§2.1): in `contentSecurityPolicy` (`composition/human/hosted-config.ts:55-67`), set `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com` and add `font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com`.
3. **Shell** (§1):
   - Add a new `KhalaApp` frame (`ui/khala/KhalaApp.tsx`) that renders `<div class="khala-app" data-theme>` + `<section class="section-card kh-card">` with the list column (brand row + list slot), the main column (container `khm`), the detail slot, a popover host and a toast host.
   - Rewire `OwnerShell`/`PendingOwnerShell` (`mount.tsx:163-288` at `5db209cc`, which KM-120 reshapes) to render `KhalaApp` instead of `AiurShell`.
   - Move the theme toggle and Log out into `.kh-brand-actions`.
   - Delete the ☰ drawer, `.khala-mobile-bar` and `#khala-channel-toolbar` portal plumbing.
   - Derive `.in-thread` from the route (`/channels/…`).
4. **Shared primitives** (`ui/khala/`):
   - `identity.ts`: `participantHue`, `initials`, `harnessLogo` (§3)
   - `Avatar.tsx`: kinds `agent | human | generic | more`; props `static`, `ghost`
   - `format-time.ts`: `clockLabel(d)` → `h:mm` local without meridiem; `dayLabel(d, now)` → `Today|Yesterday|Monday|EEE, MMM d`; `dayTime(d)` → `h:mm AM`
   - `icons.tsx`: every §18 icon, verbatim paths
   - `Popover.tsx` (§12.1 placement, single host)
   - `Segmented.tsx`, `Switch.tsx`
   - `Toast.tsx` (1600 ms)
   - `controls.css` (§12.2 verbatim)
5. **Split** `ui/conversation/ConversationLayout.tsx` into `ConversationList.tsx`, `ChatThread.tsx`, `ChatMessage.tsx`, `ChatSystemEvent.tsx`, `ChatComposer.tsx`, `ParticipantDetail.tsx` and `ConversationLayout.tsx`. Move the code **verbatim**; `index.ts` re-exports the same names. Create empty `ui/khala/{list,thread,header,composer,detail}.css`, imported once from `khala-app.css`. KM-181..184 own them.
6. **Shell tests:** delete the `AiurShell` topbar, nav and drawer cases that no longer exist. Rebaseline `shell.visual.spec.ts` in the pinned image.

## Contract and invariants

- **Tokens:** spec §2.2, both themes, verbatim. Example: `--surface-3: #292d34` (dark), `#e9dcbf` (light).
- **Fonts:** spec §2.1, verbatim:
  - root `font-family: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;`
  - mono `"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace` where the design uses it
  - Bungee **only** in `.kh-brand .wm`
- **Hues and initials:** spec §3.
  - `participantHue({kind:'human', isViewer:true})` → 214.
  - Other humans: `[330,150,32,265,190,0,95,280][fnv1a(ownerId)%8]`.
  - Agents: `[210,150,265,32][fnv1a(participantId)%4]`.
  - `initials('Maya Chen')` → `MC`; `initials('Kevin')` → `KE`.
- **Harness logos** from contracts.md C3 (quoted):

  ```ts
  export type Participant =
    | { matrixUserId: string; participantId: string; ownerId: string; displayName: string; kind: 'human' }
    | { matrixUserId: string; participantId: string; ownerId: string; displayName: string; kind: 'agent'; ownerLabel: string; harness: Harness }
    | { matrixUserId: string; displayName: string; kind: 'unknown' };
  ```

  `harness: 'claude'` → the imported `claude-symbol.svg`; `'codex'` → `codex-color.svg`. Copy both from `docs/design/khala-chat/source/assets/` to `apps/web/src/ui/khala/assets/`, and `import` them in `identity.ts` (Vite emits a hashed URL or a `data:` URI; both are allowed by `img-src 'self' data:`).
- **No `innerHTML`.** Every component is React.

**Modify:** the files listed in **Exclusive write surfaces**.

**Delete:**
- `AiurShell`'s `standalone` topbar and nav markup, plus their CSS in `shell/shell.css:9-262,307-383`. Keep `.sr-only` and `.panel`/`.status-badge` for non-chat routes.

### Worked example

`<KhalaApp theme="dark" list={…} main={…} detail={null} inThread={false} />` renders:

```html
<div class="khala-app" data-theme="dark"><section class="section-card kh-card" id="kh-card">
  <aside class="kh-list" aria-label="Conversations"><div class="kh-brand"><img class="brand-logo" src={aiurLogo} alt=""><a class="wm" href="/conversations" aria-label="Khala home">khala</a><span class="kh-brand-actions"><button class="tool-btn icon-only" aria-label="Toggle color theme">…</button><button class="tool-btn icon-only" aria-label="Log out">…</button></span></div>{list}</aside>
  <div class="kh-main">{main}<div class="kh-toast" role="status"></div></div>
  <aside class="kh-detail" aria-label="Participant details"></aside>
  <div class="kh-pop" hidden></div>
</section></div>
```

The "Live" badge renders only when a `live` prop is true. Computed at 1440×900: `.kh-list` is 300px wide; `.kh-card` is 1440×900.

### Steps

1. Copy spec §2.2 tokens and the §2.2 base rules into `brand/tokens.css`, under `.khala-app`/`[data-theme=light]`. Map the `--khala-*` aliases. Delete `--khala-font-heading` and its two uses (`shell/shell.css:27,271`).
2. In `index.html`, add the three `<link>` lines from §2.1 verbatim, set `viewport-fit=cover` and add `<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark light">` (it already exists; keep it).
3. Update the CSP and its test (step 2 of **Scope**).
4. Write `khala-app.css` with §1.3 + §1.4 + §1.5 (`.kh-card` grid from §1.5 / the design's `:414-415`) + §14 responsive rules + §15 reduced motion + §16 focus rules + §3 avatar CSS. Write `controls.css` with §12.2 verbatim. Re-root every `html[data-theme="light"]` to `.khala-app[data-theme="light"]`.
5. Build `identity.ts`, `format-time.ts`, `icons.tsx`, `Avatar.tsx`, `Popover.tsx` (§12.1), `Segmented.tsx` (§12.2 DOM), `Switch.tsx` and `Toast.tsx`, each with unit tests.
6. Split `ConversationLayout.tsx` (step 5 of **Scope**). Make no logic change; update only the imports in consumers (`features/channel/ChannelScreen.tsx:8`, `features/timeline/TimelineScreen.tsx:19-20`, `ui/conversation/fixture.tsx:2`, `landing/showcase.tsx:3`). `index.ts` keeps exporting the same symbols.
7. Build `KhalaApp.tsx`. Switch `OwnerShell` and `PendingOwnerShell` to it. Remove the drawer. The `/conversations` list column holds `ConversationList`; `/channels/:id` puts the channel screen into `main`. ≤900 shows one pane.
8. Change `screen.tsx` so the default (non-owner) shell also renders inside `.khala-app` (signed-out and status states use `.kh-state` in `main`).
9. Update the shell tests. Rebaseline the visuals in the pinned image: `docker run --rm -v "$PWD:$PWD" -w "$PWD" mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble sh -c 'corepack pnpm --filter @khala/web test:visual -- --update-snapshots'`.

## Test scenarios

- `ui/khala/identity.test.ts`:
  1. Viewer → 214.
  2. The same `ownerId` always gives the same hue.
  3. Every agent hue is in `[210,150,265,32]`.
  4. `initials`: `Maya Chen`→`MC`, `kai.watanabe`→`KW`, `Kevin`→`KE`, `You`→`YO`.
  5. `harnessLogo('codex')` returns the imported `codex-color.svg` URL.
- `ui/khala/format-time.test.ts`:
  1. `clockLabel` of 22:05 local → `10:05`.
  2. `dayLabel` → `Today`, `Yesterday` and a weekday within 6 days, else `Thu, Sep 24`.
  3. `dayTime` → `9:41 AM`.
- `ui/khala/Avatar.test.tsx`:
  1. An agent renders `button.kh-av` with `--h`, an `img` and `.kh-own` with `--oh`.
  2. `static` renders a `span`.
  3. `ghost` adds `.ghost` and `aria-hidden`.
  4. A human renders `.kh-hav` with initials.
- `ui/khala/Popover.test.tsx`:
  1. The anchor in the left half aligns left; in the right half it aligns right.
  2. Clamped to 8px.
  3. Flips above on bottom overflow.
  4. Escape closes it and focus returns to the anchor.
  5. An outside click closes it.
- `ui/khala/KhalaApp.test.tsx`:
  1. `.kh-brand .wm` text is `khala`.
  2. The brand actions hold the theme toggle and Log out.
  3. `inThread` toggles `.in-thread`.
  4. No element other than `.wm` has the class `wm`.
- `composition/human/hosted-config.test.ts`: the CSP contains `font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com` and `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com`.
- `shell/shell.browser.spec.ts` (rewritten):
  1. At 1440, computed `font-family` of `body`, `.kh-list-head b` and buttons starts with `"Space Grotesk"`, and `.kh-brand .wm` starts with `Bungee`.
  2. At 390, list view shows the brand row, and thread view hides the list.
  3. There is no `.aiur-shell__topbar` in the DOM.

## Risks and stop conditions

- If KM-120 has not merged, stop. `mount.tsx` will conflict.
- If adding Google font origins to the CSP is rejected in review on privacy grounds, stop and ask the Executor. Do not silently self-host; that would contradict the operator directive.
- If the component split changes any test outcome, revert to a pure move and report it.

## Complexity rationale

3: a shell swap across composition, CSP and visual baselines, plus about 10 small primitives. The behaviour is unchanged.
